name: Fizsprockets Notizen
summary: In the Venture Co. mine, Morin Cloudstalker seeks the notebook pages still missing. They hold important information about the company's schemes in the region.

sections.title: The Missing Pages
sections.body: Morin Cloudstalker waits at Bloodhoof Village for the pages still missing from Fizsprocket’s notebook. You have found folded pages in Fizsprocket’s pocket, and the remaining notes lie in the Venture Co. mine. Their information can guide what comes next.

faq.q: What pages am I looking for?
faq.answer: You are looking for the remaining pages of Overseer Fizsprocket’s notebook.

faq.q: Where are the rest of the notes?
faq.answer: The remaining pages are in the Venture Co. mine.
Morin Cloudstalker is waiting for the pages at Bloodhoof Village.
The notebook contains important information about the Venture Co. and its schemes in the region.
